name: hcapp_getEventBadgeCount
description: Returns unread event message badge counts. Three modes: (1) reset all badge counts for the user, (2) reset + read badge count for a specific event, (3) read badge count for a specific event. Uses MERGE for upsert on EventMessageBadgeCounts.

parameters.name: publicEventId
parameters.description: Public event ID to get badge count for. Null = get counts for all events.

parameters.name: resetBadgeCount
parameters.description: When non-zero, marks the specific event's messages as read via MERGE. Default 0.

parameters.name: resetAllBadgeCounts
parameters.description: When non-zero, marks all event messages as read for this user. Overrides publicEventId mode. Default 0.

columns.name: BadgeCount
columns.description: Unread message count for this event. NULL if no badge record exists.

rowsets.name: AllEventBadgeCounts
rowsets.description: Returned when @publicEventId is null and @resetAllBadgeCounts=0. One row per event with unread messages.

columns.name: BadgeCount
columns.description: Unread message count for this event.

sideEffects: MERGE HC.EventMessageBadgeCounts — when @resetBadgeCount != 0 (marks event as read)
INSERT HC.ErrorLog on null-user and auth-failure paths

codeSmells.detail: Local variable declared as @timeWindows instead of @timeWindow. Consistent with other SPs but still a typo.

codeSmells.issue: Commented-out eventId validation — no guard on null @publicEventId in single-event mode
codeSmells.detail: The eventId null check is commented out. When @publicEventId is null and @resetAllBadgeCounts=0, the query runs against a null event ID, returning an empty result set rather than an error.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
